ja.title: 「18年前にたくさんのメロディーを書きました」 - 『シャドウ ブレイド ゼロ』音楽監督ボー・ツァイシェン氏独占インタビュー
ja.summary: 今年9月、北京で『シャドウブレード ゼロ』のオフライン体験会が開催された。私も幸運にも、プレイヤーの期待を集めるこの「カンフーパンク」の傑作をいち早く垣間見ることができました。武道をテーマにしたテンポの速いアクション ゲームであるこのゲームは、音楽の面でも独特の体験を私にもたらしてくれました。これらは当然ながら、一連のゲームの音楽ディレクターであり、私たちのマシンコアの古い友人である Bo Caisheng のおかげです。 18 年前のインディーズ ゲーム「Rainblood」から、その後の「Shadow Blade」シリーズ、そして今日の AAA レベルの「Shadow Blade Zero」に至るまで、Bo Caisheng の音楽は常にこのシリーズの重要な部分を占めてきました。この貴重な機会を利用して、私たちは幸運にもボー・カイシェン氏に再びインタビューすることができました。プロデューサーのリャン・チーウェイ（S）との10年以上の協力から始まり、今回の3Aレベルの制作に直面する際に音楽デザインがもたらす課題、そしてプレイヤーが最も懸念していること、つまりゲーム音楽で大成功を待つものについて話しました。

en.title: "I wrote many melodies 18 years ago" - Exclusive interview with Bo Caisheng, music director of "Shadow Blade Zero"
en.summary: In September this year, “Shadow Blade Zero” held an offline trial session in Beijing. I was also fortunate to have an early glimpse of this "Kung Fu Punk" masterpiece that is highly anticipated by players. As a fast-paced action game with a martial arts theme, this game brought me a unique experience of its own in terms of music. And these are naturally due to the music director of the series of games and an old friend of our machine core - Bo Caisheng. From the independent game "Rainblood" 18 years ago, to the later "Shadow Blade" series, to today's AAA-level "Shadow Blade Zero", Bo Caisheng's music has always been an important part of this series. Taking advantage of this rare opportunity, we were also fortunate to interview Mr. Bo Caisheng again: starting from his more than ten years of cooperation with producer Liang Qiwei (S), we talked about the challenges brought by music design when facing 3A-level production this time, and what players are most concerned about - what awaits great success in game music.

en.title: Preview of "Shadow Blade Zero": A quite complete journey of exploration and combat
en.summary: On September 3, Chule participated in the closed offline trial session of "Shadow Blade Zero" at the invitation of Lingyoufang. The important thing about this demo is that the version available at the event is arguably not that different from the version that will be released soon. During the approximately 5 hours of trial play, we had a relatively complete experience of the story opening, plot CG, level design and boss battles, and even details such as controller feedback. The process covered the entire first chapter of the big map, hidden maps, hidden bosses, a small amount of the second chapter content and two later bosses. If the previous demos released sporadically by Lingyoufang still gave people a feeling of peeking into the background, this time the demos make people feel quite reassured about the overall quality of the game. In terms of exploration and combat experience, "Shadow Blade Zero" maintains a consistently high level; in particular, games in the past have shown less in terms of levels and development, and this time it also brought us the biggest surprise. The newly encountered bosses each have their own characteristics.

This is a new top-down action RPG that combines light survival and construction gameplay. Players will step into a carefully crafted mythical open world. Here, the myths of different civilizations such as Northern Europe, Greece, and Egypt intersect and coexist. It not only supports solo exploration, but also allows you to team up with friends and embark on an epic adventure together. In "New Gods", players will play the role of "gods" - a group of unknown descendants of the gods who unexpectedly survived Ragnarok, and their legends are still to be written. With the power of the Goddess, players will rise from the ruins after the catastrophe, repair the broken World Tree seeds, and restore balance to the universe. In the process of exploring the world, players can transform into mythical creatures such as phoenixes, manticores, and sirens, climb over mountains, cross oceans, and soar into the sky.
